snippet.title: MARVEL Cosmic Invasion | Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
A cosmic battle awaits as MARVEL Cosmic Invasion releases for PC, Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series S|X consoles!

Get it NOW: https://marvelcosmicinvasiongame.com/

🦸‍♂️ Choose from 15 Marvel Super Heroes in this fast and heavy-hitting action beat ‘em up
💥 Fight against the deadly Annihilation Wave threatening the galaxy
🌐 Take multi-player brawling from New York City to the depths of the Negative Zone

The battle for the future of the Marvel Universe will be fought across the stars!

For more MARVEL Cosmic Invasion updates, join us on social media:
X / Twitter: https://x.com/MARVELCosmicInv
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/MARVELCosmicInvasion
Discord: https://discord.com/invite/KSq4P8NeAE
